title: Everest Lab Annual Meeting 2025
location: MIT Building 45, 8th Floor · 51 Vassar Street, Cambridge, MA
description: Lab members and speakers from Amazon, Intel, TWG, and Accenture gave talks on AI infrastructure, AI programming, ML for systems, AI for data science, and multimodal AI. The day closed with a brainstorming session, a poster session, and a reception.
